questions.title: Generator Body Runs Lazily
questions.description: gen prints a line before its first yield; g is created and next(g) is called once. What prints?
questions.codesnippet:
def gen():
    print("first next")
    yield 1
    print("second next")
    yield 2

g = gen()
print("created")
print(next(g))

questions.title: Genexp Stays Lazy
questions.description: A generator expression over nums is created, then nums.append(4) runs before sum consumes it. What prints?
questions.Option1: 14 - the genexp froze the original contents
questions.Option2: 30 - the genexp sees the appended 4 at consumption time
questions.Option3: 1 - only the first element is squared
questions.Option4: TypeError - lists cannot change during iteration
questions.codesnippet:
nums = [1, 2, 3]
squares = (n * n for n in nums)
nums.append(4)
print(sum(squares))

questions.title: Yield Resumes With State
questions.description: counter(start) increments n before each yield inside while True. What do the three next() calls print?
questions.Option4: a StopIteration traceback after the first value
questions.codesnippet:
def counter(start):
    n = start
    while True:
        n += 1
        yield n

c = counter(10)
print(next(c))
print(next(c))
print(next(c))

questions.title: Next With Default
questions.description: two_step yields 'a' then 'b'; next is called three times with the default 'empty'. What prints?
questions.codesnippet:
def two_step():
    yield "a"
    yield "b"

g = two_step()
print(next(g, "empty"))
print(next(g, "empty"))
print(next(g, "empty"))
